reviews.text:
Gary, the owner, is absolutely hilarious, and he and his entire team are truly some of the most genuine, salt-of-the-earth people you will ever meet. It is so clear that they genuinely care, not just about training your dog, but about the relationship you have with your pet and helping you build a stronger bond together.

Throughout Lilly’s training, I received updates on her progress, and they were mostly flexible with scheduling our in-person lessons. Gary personally went above and beyond on several different occasions to help me navigate situations, and that kind of care and dedication is something you just don’t find everywhere.

Our sweet Lilly girl was in wonderful hands, and I am so grateful we found All Around K9. You can tell these people truly love what they do, and even more importantly, they care about the people and pups they work with.

If you’re looking for a dog trainer who combines knowledge, humor, patience, and genuine heart, look no further. Gary and his team are the real deal! Five stars simply don’t do them justice.
Can't say enough of just how amazing and professional Gary and his staff are! Thank you so much for your time and help Gary! 5/5! Semper Brotha.

A huge thank you to Gary and his entire team for going above and beyond in training our dog Tex. Their dedication, patience and hard work have made such a positive impact on Tex.
We are grateful for everything they have done. If we could give more than 5 stars, we absolutely would.
We highly recommend Gary and his entire team for professional, effective and dedication dog training.
They are simply the BEST!!!

I scheduled an evaluation for our Jax with Gary and the experience was amazing. Gary's approach on meeting our boy for the 1st time was awesome. His calm positive method was absolutely incredible. I can't wait to see where the 3 wk board and train takes us. I will definitely do an update.
Gary and Tara were so fun to work with. It’s obvious that they are passionate about what they do. I can now safely walk my 90lb dog on a leash with my stroller in public places!

If you’re looking invest in your new family puppy or needing help with an existing older dog adjust then  look no further! AAK9 Training  is equipped to personalize your dog’s needs.
I have used another dog obedience training program over the years and hands down they are no comparable to the professional focused staff of trainers at AAK9 Training. Gary and his staff are dedicated to detail training based on the owner’s needs & the dog’s behaviors. Don’t wait & become frustrated with your puppy or older adult dog as you try to understand what’s wrong with your new fur baby why they aren’t adjusting in with the rest of the family! We spend vast amounts of $$$ on dog accessories and neglect the obvious needs of our dogs. If, you have children then you understand they required you to teach them on how to learn! Your dog is no different, make the decision to take them “to school” and get educated. The trainers, like Kae are very knowledgeable, professional, and very personal to their craft with meeting your dogs/family needs. Like anything in life, your family comes 1st and if you decide to add a new family dog then they are now part of that equation & you invest accordingly. Highly recommend Gary and his entire team at AAK9 Training.
Thanks,
Robert Wampler

I was so nervous for the eval and Gary could tell. He immediately reassured me and put me at ease. He is incredibly knowledgeable about dogs and behavior. I learned so much in just that hour. I highly recommend.

We took our rambunctious standard poodle to Tara and Gary for off leash training. Her impulsiveness has ended and obedience is amazing now!  Roxy is such a smart dog and taking her here has helped her grow and become such a great companion!

Our dog Martin Seligman is an Irish wolfhound puppy and from his size alone could be dangerous. He boarded with K9 for two weeks and I’m absolutely amazed at how well behaved and the training was fantastic. He is not even five months old and behaves like the most well trained puppy I’ve seen in my entire life. We can take him anywhere and now we are not worried that his size will put us in danger. He does not pull on the leash he listens to commands quickly. They also taught us the skills that we need to continue his training so that he continues to behave well. 10 out of five stars I’d give them if I could

Gary and our trainer, Kae were awesome! We took our high-energy, curious, very smart rescue pup in at around 4 months. The most important piece is the owner education and being able to keep up with her training afterwards. We did a 14-day board and train. We have a very controlled pup who’s still the sweetest, friendliest, little social butterfly to exist! I was very impressed at how many people we’ve gone up to, kiddos, other animals, and she’s just very controlled but friendly. She’s not jumping and listens very well with proper corrections. She pushes the limits but because of the training they also give to the owner- I’m able to handle her very well. I’m also glad Kae was able to show us how to handle her when she comes in contact with something she’s scared of. Though she’s pretty fearless, we were able to understand when those moments do happen and how we handle them with her because they could make or break. We will be going back after she hits 6 months for E collar training so we can work on her able to be off leash. The biggest benefit, outside of owner education, with this program, is the confidence building and all of the things our pup was exposed to in order to show her it’s ok. Very happy with this program! She also likes watching cartoons now and stays very curious!

They have trained both of my dogs! My English and French bulldog. I could not be happier with the education they have received. Both of my boys have learned so much and are completely manageable for me to handle in public and on walks, etc. My dogs absolutely love their trainers and the facility as well! Both of my babies went to basic obedience school and then remote collar training, and it was the best investment I could have ever made.

Gary, Tara, and the rest of the crew were absolutely amazing with our Bluetick Mere! Our house went from chaos to calm, and we are so overjoyed with the results from our weeks of training! They listened, cared, and helped us learn how to control our puppy while still letting her be a puppy, and keep her full sassy personality. We cannot thank the crew enough!

All Around K9 Training took such beautiful care of Cookiedough. From the moment we walked in, it felt like he was being treated by people who truly saw him, his quirks, his sweetness, and his potential. The patience and kindness they showed made such a difference, and we could see him growing more confident every day. As a family, we felt supported, understood, and included in his progress. It meant a lot to us. This experience was absolutely a 5.

My husband and I were so pleased and blown away by All Around K9 with our dog Cleo, that we knew we had to send our other dog Lily with them too. Lily is a wonderful, 6 year old pup that may be too smart for her own good, stubborn, and very independently minded. Overall, Lily had a decent foundation but required work on some things (reactivity, leash pulling, recall). Walking was stressful, being around other pets was a major uncertainty, and her recall was a safety concern due to her being bit by a copperhead in the past.

When she was about 3 years old, a family member was walking Lily around new years when people set off fireworks in their driveway right next to her. Lily managed to run away while still being on the leash. Her leash got caught and wrapped around a pole and she was stuck trying to run away while the fireworks were exploding next to her. After this incident, Lily developed severe PTSD from fireworks and other loud noises such as people moving their trash cans out during trash day, and the smell of smoke. Every 4th of July and New Years, we dreaded having to see our dog suffer while people celebrated. Lily would often tremble and salivate for hours. We eventually had to heavily medicate her with multiple sedatives just so she could halfway cope with it.

We were saddened to see Lily’s personality fade as she was heavily sedated most of the time. After All Around K-9 helped our other dog Cleo, we knew they could help Lily, and it would only be fair that both our dogs had the same set of rules and standards. We sent Lily with Clay as soon as we got Cleo back.

Clay worked with Lily and did the monumental task of systematically desensitizing Lily to fireworks and loud noises. He started small with snappers and worked his way up to real fireworks. Clay once again went above and beyond for us and Lily to train her and it was a bonus that when we had our training sessions with Lily, Clay also worked with us and Cleo some more. All Around K-9 really caters to the individual dog and family as a whole by creating personalized trainings for that unique environment.

Clay did an amazing job not only training us for Lily, but also training us for both Cleo and Lily together. Clay’s training sessions with us never felt rushed, and he stayed until all our questions were answered and we felt comfortable.

Lily now no longer pulls on the leash, barks and whines at other dogs, and comes to the door promptly when calling her. Clay also demonstrated for us Lily’s improvement with firework noises. During one of our training sessions he used the poppers (which were not quiet) and Lily handled it so well! She was a little nervous but recovered almost instantly and went about her day. We feel so relieved to have Lily at a much much better place and happy we know how to work her through things when the real holidays arrive. She’s no longer on medication too and is her old self! We took her off before we sent her too.

Having both Lily and Cleo trained has made our lives a dream. Before, when walking both dogs alone, each would be pulling me in different directions and reacting to environmentals. We now walk both our dogs with both leashes in one hand and them walking at the same pace and right next to each other. They both almost act in perfect harmony with commands. It’s really like something out of a movie, and we cannot believe that it is actually possible that our dogs have this level of obedience and training. It really speaks to the quality of care and training that Gary, Clay, and All Around K-9 provide, to be able to train two very different dogs with two different issues, and have them come together with that level of synchrony.

Both of our dogs have such a high level of confidence in themselves and we are so proud of them and grateful to Clay, Gary, and All Around K-9. We truly feel unstoppable now that both of our dogs are doing so well. We look forward to enjoying a more fulfilling life for all of us. Highly recommend All Around K-9! They have changed our lives! Thank you so much!

LIFE CHANGING!

In November of 2025 my wife and I adopted a beautiful dog that her brother found in the neighborhood that had been dumped on the streets and starved until she was about 20 pounds. We were so lucky to get her and she has a beautiful personality. Due to her trauma, she experienced severe separation anxiety that would leave us worrying about her when we left for work. She also had some other obedience issues like jumping on people and opening the door to let herself out. With our busy schedules, we simply did not have the time to train her and needed to get her help so that she could live a happier life.

We found All Around k-9 training and was instantly drawn to Gary due to his specialized and extensive experience training and handling dogs. Gary got us in for a consultation right away. He took the time to explain to us all the tools they use and showed us the training environment and what their approach was. We instantly felt comfortable with him and were left with no doubts. Gary’s expertise was evident right away and he even got her comfortable in the crate within 5 minutes and drastically improved her aversion. We were blown away.

Dropping Cleo off was one of the hardest things we have ever done, as we were scared and broken hearted how she would handle the board and train due to her history of being dumped and recently getting comfortable with us.

Clay was our assigned dog trainer, and we were so lucky to get him. Clay went out of his way and went above and beyond to train Cleo and work with our busy schedules to make sure we had the training to keep up the work they did. Clay focused the majority of the first week building a bond with Cleo and that foundation of trust. We were sent detailed updates every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday with pictures. The very first picture we got, our minds were put instantly at ease as we could see her smiling and clearly having a great time with Clay. Clay’s passion for what he does is so incredible and he is extremely gifted at what he does.

After 3 weeks, Cleo came back to our house and it was one of the most moving experiences of our lives to see without a doubt that Cleo had her life back. Her confidence is so high, she is no longer scared of things, being in public, or even just exploring around. We no longer worry about her being in the house in the crate while we are at work. Within the first week, we got two compliments from strangers while out with her due to her obedience and calmness around environmentals. Clay, Gary, and All Around K9 Training gave Cleo back her life, and helped her realize that a bad experience doesn’t have to mean you have to live your life in fear forever. The amount of freedom and peace of mind we have and the opportunities are endless now. We have absolute confidence in taking her in public, whether that be parks, restaurants, or stores. Cleo went from being our pet to our companion. Of course she still experiences a little separation anxiety, but both Cleo and us have the tools and confidence to work through it and we know that within a matter of time that will resolve. The work must be put on your end to continue to set the high standards and not get complacent. If you follow their guidance though, you will find yourself very successful and even able to sharpen some skills even more.

Do not hesitate to choose All Around K-9 training. Their services are priceless and the results speak for themselves. They are all extremely knowledgeable, caring, and kind people and professionals. We are so lucky that our paths crossed!

I had a great conversation and evaluation with Gary. I didn’t end up enrolling in a training program, but what I learned from just a couple of hours with Gary was very valuable! Would definitely recommend, and will be reaching out for future training if the need arises.

The AAK9 team is amazing. We did a two week board and train followed by weekly lessons for 6 weeks. Before AAK9 we couldn’t take our 1.5 year old lab in public or walk him around on leash him due to his excitement and anxiety. Now? Night and day difference. He is so much more calm and well behaved in public settings and we can comfortably take him on walks!

We sent our three year old German Shepard for the four week training program. There aren’t enough words to explain how great of an experience this was. Gary and his team do an amazing job. Our trainer, Justin, kept us informed every step of the way. Our training sessions were thorough and we were given all the tools to train our dog properly. From sending away a reactive dog to getting back one that is neutral around other dogs is unbelievable. I would recommend Gary and his team to anyone looking to train their dogs.
Thank you, Paul, for the fantastic 5-star review! We appreciate your support and are thrilled you had a great experience. We look forward to serving you again soon.

I can’t say enough great things about All Around K9 Training! My dog, Snoop, stayed with them for two weeks, and he came home like a different dog. The improvement in his behavior and confidence has been amazing, and it’s clear he was well cared for throughout his stay.

A huge thank you to Kae, Gary, and the entire staff for treating Snoop like family. They were professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely cared about his success. It gave me so much peace of mind knowing he was in such good hands.

If you’re looking for a place that truly cares about your dog and delivers real results, I highly recommend All Around K9 Training!

Our trainer Kay was outstanding with our Pup Snoop ..
K was able to meet all our expectations. The turnout for our snoop was excellent. He’s very disciplined and obedient and at the same time he loves to have fun thank you Kay for doing such a remarkable and outstanding work with our snoop…… I thank  everyone for the love care and support that you have shown us and our Snoop
Off-Leash K9 and Geoff has been great and a big help with my 9 month old puppy! Greatly appreciated the daily updates and videos watching the progress. Highly recommend!
We really enjoyed all around k9 taking the time to train us how to utilize the tools appropriately. Coco is a young puppy And we're excited to have a lifelong training we can utilize.

Me and my partner went in with low hopes in being able to reunite our dogs or make any progress, especially because my dog is dog aggressive. But with all of the education and lessons Gary taught us it made us realize how much we were letting our dogs do things that they shouldn't do which contributed to their issues. We are so glad we went, Gary is very different from other trainers I've gone to, he may curse up a storm 😂 but you can tell he really is dedicated to his training, and it makes him seem alot more transparent. They are proactive with tracking progress as well and always hope for the best for you and your pets. It is well worth every penny!
We learned a lot. I can control my much better around cats and other fast moving  beasts. She does not try to dominate the other.

I checked with a number of trainers and companies, and the first sign that All Around was the best choice for my family and Sati was the initial consultation and introduction.
As a shelter adoption, Sati had issues with being around new people and other dogs. Within the first consultation, Gary had her around new people and dogs with little reaction. Our trainer, Jason, helped her to become the dog I knew she could be, and he even introduced her to some new friends along the way. I truly believe that the dog we already loved now has a much happier life; we are finally able to take her out with us, and she is comfortable meeting family and friends. The training at All Around is top-notch and absolutely worth it. Thanks for all you guys do and have done for our family and Sati!

Our experience was great! Clay was an excellent trainer, and I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for dog training. These guys truly know what they’re doing and genuinely care about your dog like it’s their own. We felt supported throughout the process and really appreciated the attention and care they gave. Highly recommend!

My experience was excellent and made a major difference in my relationship with my dog. It’s important that the pet owner knows to continue the training at home. The staff was always eager to answer any questions even after training was over. I highly recommend this program to help their dog to be the best it can be.

We sent our 16wk puppy, Bash, and 5 year old dog, Kali, to board and train. Our puppy for 2 weeks and dog for 3. You get multiple trainings throughout the boarding to really have a good foundation for them coming back home. We see a huge improvement for the both of them. The highlight recently was being able to walk both of them at the same time with no stress of pulling. Incredibly thankful for everyone we worked with. Our two trainers were Clay and Jason and they were very knowledgeable.

My reactive dog and I had a great experience with Gary and Clay. They helped teach me how to handle my pup better when he is in those reactive moments and how to get ahead of it. I saw progress within the very first lesson. I would definitely recommend them to anyone who needs dog training
Met Gary 2 weeks ago . Gave my puppy 2 week  training. Wonderful Job. Highly recommend!!

I have used all around K9 to train both of my rotties and they did a great job with my dogs and my family.  Gary and Clay wonderful trainers and full of knowledge. I would definitely recommend all around if you’re looking for a trainer for your dogs. They have made an our lives so much better.

Gary and his staff are excellent! We had such a wonderful experience with Gary and All Around K9 Training; I can't thank them enough for all they did! They truly go above and beyond. My dog responded so well to the training he received; I highly recommend their services!

There are not enough good things I can say about AAK9. We took our European Doberman, Cairo, to them as a puppy (around 6 months) for their board and train program and again at about a year old. Due to him being a large breed, that can have a bad wrap, and also having two small and old dogs at home, we wanted to make sure he was well behaved and socialized. It was hands down the BEST investment we made! They not only trained our dog, but us as the owners, which was probably the hardest part honestly, but they were/are so patient and kind with us. Now, at 2 years old and 115 lbs, everywhere we go, we are always complimented on how well behaved he is. Even when other dogs are barking at him and going crazy, he just stares at them and keeps moving, never reacts. As small/family business owners ourselves, we love that this is all done with the family and staff that is as close as family. I also like that they will only board dogs that have been trained by them. Cairo LOVES when he is dropped off for boarding here, doesn't even turn around to look at us, just starts running the property like he owns the place. This tells us that he is well cared for and gives us the peace of mind we need when leaving our family member there for long periods of time. I will always and ONLY recommend AAK9 for all dogs and owners!
Thanks to Gary and Jason for getting our 4 month old Malinois. All Around K9 set our pup and my wife and up for success. We couldn’t be happier with the results!

We had such a great experience with All Around K9 Training and truly can’t recommend them enough!

One of my favorite parts was the consistent communication, they sent detailed updates three times a week with fun pictures and videos, which gave us so much peace of mind while our dog was there. It also made us feel really connected to her progress along the way.

I especially loved that they incorporated multiple training sessions during the boarding period. Being able to see our dog, learn alongside her, and then have time to process everything before the next session made a huge difference. It built so much confidence for our whole family and made the transition of bringing her home feel smooth and manageable.

The team was incredibly friendly and supportive from start to finish. You can tell they genuinely love what they do and truly care about the dogs they work with.

Another fun bonus was how active they are on Instagram, it was always such a treat to occasionally see extra photos or videos pop up unexpectedly!

Most importantly, our dog is doing AMAZING. The results speak for themselves, and it was absolutely worth every penny. We’re so grateful for the care and training she received!!!

Our miniature poodle Ollie, did a two week board and train here. He went in unwillingly to listen and had the attitude that he could do whatever he wanted.
Coming out of this he’s been a great listener. Calmer, and understands the rules put in place. We’ve continued working with him and he’s becoming such a sweet, well-behaving pup.

We went with the 3 week board and train package for Bear, and could not be more pleased with the outcome.  Bear is an American Bully mix and at roughly 10-12 months of age, he still has high energy and a lot of puppy in him.  During each training session we noticed large improvements in his confidence, stability, and overall manners.  We had weekly training visits that helped us build our confidence and trust with Bear while working on and off leash.  Between Clay and Gary, we were informed on all of Bear's progressions throughout the entire process via text messages accompanied with pictures of our boy.  We picked him up today after the completion of his 3 week board and train.  We are so happy to have our boy back home, and I cannot thank everyone at All Around K9 Training enough for what they have done.

I was so impressed with the training that Millie received. This program helped her come out of her shell and let her personality shine even more. She is so much more confident and obedient. I now have the tools to continue training at home. I felt very supported throughout the whole process and can't say enough great things about Gary and Clay. I think this was the best thing I could've done for her.

We had a great experience with AAK9. Clay was our trainer and he was very easy to work with and helped us to feel more confident in handling our pup as well as helped our dog navigate through her anxiety in social situations. Id recommend Clay and AAK9 to anyone. 10/10 experience

We have a dog named, Kolohe and she is an active, playful, and spunky pup. We felt we needed help with fine tuning behavioral issues. Typical puppy things like, nipping, jumping on everyone, not taking most of our commands. It was frustrating for us, and her as well. I met with Gary, the owner and he did a great job of explaining what they do and sharing his experience with dogs. We were connected to one of his lead trainers, Jason since our home was closer to his location. Kolohe spent 3 weeks with Jason. We met each week to also receive our training as her owners so it would be seamless when she came home. Jason had amazing communication skills the entire time and kept us abreast of her progress the whole time. He sent pictures and videos throughout the training too. We went on a vacation that was scheduled after her training and I was much more comfortable with Jason boarding her than taking her to our vet's office for boarding. He even sent me pictures while she was boarding. I trust them with our Kolohe and highly recommend All Around K9 Training!

It has been over a week since my puppy, Billie, completed the two-week Board & Train program with Clay, and she is a completely different puppy—in the best way.

She walks significantly better, listens more, is much more confident, and is excited to learn new things. Of course, she can still be a little stubborn and likes to test what she can get away with. But as long as I stay persistent and keep not only Billie but myself accountable, we’re able to work through it together.

I really appreciated all of the updates that were sent while Billie was away. Any concerns or questions I had were addressed right away and explained thoroughly. Overall, the support I received was top tier.

Clay also made sure I left with the tools and guidance needed to continue working with Billie at home. I enjoy practicing with her every day to reinforce what she learned and to introduce new things. She already knows her routine and is excited to go for walks, which is something she used to dread.

I’m excited to keep building on her training and continue this little adventure with Billie. If you’re looking for someone who truly cares about your pups and delivers real results, I highly recommend All Around K9 Training.

We had an incredible experience with All Around K9! Gary, Tara and their team did an amazing job training our dog, Teddy. The 3 week board and train program alone made a huge difference, but what really stood out was the education they provided us on the tools (e-collar, crate training, etc) and how to manage our older senior dog. That guidance gave us the confidence to continue reinforcing everything at home.

Because of their training, we now have a well-behaved dog who truly fits our lifestyle. It has made everyday life so much more enjoyable and stress-free.

What truly sets them apart is both a deep understanding of dog behavior and continued opportunities for check-ins and maintenance walks. Everyone at AAK9 are just genuinely good people that care about the long-term success of both the dogs and their owners.

They are, without a doubt, the best trainers we have ever worked with. We’re so grateful for their continued support and we will definitely have them training our future dogs!

My dog Siren has gotten training from them several times for obedience while she was growing up. She’s now two years old and developed a fear of men, unrelated to the training. But with the help of AAK9, I’ve been able to implement methods of keeping her comfortable and confident around people and she just got excited to see a guy friend of mine for the first time ever!! She’s never gotten excited to see a male that wasn’t family so this is huge progress! Thanks to the AAK9 team for all the help!

our pup Beau entered as a young pup; now, he’s obedient and easy to control. As a young 7 month old, he’s mastered to his age very well- directly attributable to the great hands on training. i highly recommend this pup training location- its second to none!!

Loved the atmosphere and the no bad questions environment. Gary and Tara are so caring and neighborly. Kay is a great teacher and I love that she loves digs. Very heart felt and informative. Their loving approach to dogs gives me hope in this crazy world, maybe training our universe is a good idea😉

This is the 2nd time I've used AA9K. Highly recommend. Gary runs a fantastic facility. I've had the pleasure of working with two different trainers now. Recent one is Clay. Super responsive, very personable, and overall great a trainer. We took our pup who is 16 weeks old. He came back with a great understanding of commands, his confidence has grown tremendously, and his stability for being so young is phenomenal. Would absolutely trust them with anything regarding your pups. Thanks again!
Gary and Tara are the best! Highly recommend.

We missed this girl so much, but it was absolutely worth it! Huge thank you to All Around K9 Training for everything you did for Tiny and for me. The training not only boosted Tiny’s confidence, but also helped us communicate better and strengthened our bond.

Tiny used to be very anxious, reactive to other dogs, and unsure of herself. Now she’s more confident, calmer, and we have the tools to keep building on the solid foundation your team gave us.

You can truly tell everyone there cares deeply about the dogs and the families they work with, and it shows in the quality of training and support they provide.

If you’re looking for training for your furry family member, I can’t recommend them enough. Thank you again to the entire All Around K9 team for everything you do!

The AAK9 team is truly outstanding. I had the privilege of randomly meeting Gary in my neighborhood while he was working with another dog and owner, and I’m so grateful our paths crossed. After an incident with one of my three dogs, I knew it was time to take action and reached out to AAK9. I can’t express how thankful I am for Gary and his entire team. They were incredibly knowledgeable, patient, and supportive throughout the process, helping not only my dogs, but also my wife and me. The guidance and education we received made a huge difference, and I’m forever grateful for the positive impact they’ve had on our family.

I could never recommend AAK9 enough! Sending my Boerboel, Primo, to the 2-week board and train was the best decision I could’ve made — not just for him, but for myself too. Gary, Kae, and the entire team of trainers are incredibly knowledgeable and truly take pride in their work.

From the very beginning, they made me feel confident that Primo was in the best hands. The communication, the structure, and the care they put into every detail exceeded my expectations. Primo came home more confident, obedient, and balanced, and I finally feel equipped with the tools I need to keep him on the right path.

AAK9 gave us both exactly what we needed, and I’m so grateful for their dedication. I wouldn’t trust my dog with anyone else!

After completing the 3-week board and train program with my dog Opal, I can confidently say that working with Gary and Clay (our main trainer) at All Around K9 was one of the best decisions I’ve ever made.
Opal came from a tough background — a traumatic experience with my grandma’s “guard” dog left her reactive and fearful around other dogs and people. For years, she either bolted away or rumbled low growls anytime we encountered another dog. I spent nearly three years researching trainers before trusting All Around K9, and I’m so glad I did.
From day one, Gary and Clay took the time to evaluate Opal carefully and show me the training steps they’d use. They updated me every evening, and by the end of week one, Opal was already calmly interacting with other dogs and bonding with Clay.
Midway through training, they discovered Opal had a severe UTI that had been affecting her ability to train effectively. Instead of pausing the program, they immediately took her to the vet, got her treated, and continued her training without missing a beat. By week three, my once-fearful dog was walking through department stores and pet shops with confidence — calm, alert, and happy.
We plan to return for a few more weeks of training to build on her progress. Beyond helping Opal, Clay and Gary taught us how to truly communicate with her — to understand her body language, support her focus, and reinforce that teamwork is what she wants most. We now take Opal on errands and outings regularly, following the detailed training plan they provided, and every day she feels more balanced and excited to explore the world again.
If you’re considering professional training, I can’t recommend All Around K9 enough. It’s not just a program for your dog — it’s an education for you too.

Photo shows Opal on the right (Black Dog)

At the all around  k-9 training services has overall been an excellent experience for my puppy and I to get hands on training. Everyone is super kind, honest, and very diligent when it comes to scheduling for training. I felt very at ease knowing my puppy is in good hands with  motivational trainers that loves to see puppies strive on achieving there stability. Definitely would recommend for any future dogs. 🐶♥️

I highly recommend the AAK9 training program!  My mini poodle attended the boarding and training program to improve his confidence, curb FOMO/excessive barking/nipping/jumping on people, and develop obedience skills in general.  He is a calmer and more confident pup as a result!  He returned home with a solid understanding of the leash, obedience commands, and proper house and social manners.  Gary and Jason were great!
